citations.title: Yuen Kuan Moon - InsidEntity

sentences.text: Yuen Kuan Moon has been Group Chief Executive Officer of Singapore Telecommunications (Singtel) since 1 January 2021, a role he has held since 1 January 2021, succeeding Chua Sock Koong.

He joined Singtel in 1993 and held leadership roles in marketing, business development and sales, and in 2003 was posted to Indonesian associate Telkomsel as general manager for product development, serving as director of commerce from 2005 to 2007.

sentences.quote: Before his appointment as Group CEO, Moon was CEO, of Consumer Singapore, a post he has held since June 2012. He was also responsible for driving the Group's overall digital transformation as Group Chief Digital Officer from August 2018 to December 2020.
sentences.text: Before becoming Group CEO he was CEO, Consumer Singapore from June 2012 and drove the group's digital transformation as Group Chief Digital Officer from August 2018 to December 2020.

He directs Singtel Group's global strategy and oversees its consumer, enterprise and digital businesses, guided by the Singtel28 plan, and has overseen expansion of digital services under NCS and the creation of regional data centre business Nxera.
